body: Rapper Casanova shares a throwback video featuring ToryLanez and YNWMelly reminder of a time when all three artists were making moves in the music industry and building their names in the game. Now, with all three artists behind bars, the footage hits differently. What was once a moment of music, ambition, and brotherhood has become a reminder of how quickly life can change and how circumstances can alter the course of a career. Free Free Free.
